title: 2018 AMC 8 Problem 8
statement:
Mr. Garcia asked the members of his health class how many days last week they exercised for at least \(30\) minutes. The results are summarized in the following bar graph, where the heights of the bars represent the number of students.

What was the mean number of days of exercise last week, rounded to the nearest hundredth, reported by the students in Mr. Garcia’s class?

solutions.text:
The bar heights for \(1,2,3,4,5,6,7\) days are \(1,3,2,6,8,3,2\), for a total of \(25\) students.

The total number of reported exercise days is \[\begin{aligned} &1\cdot1+2\cdot3+3\cdot2+4\cdot6\\ &\qquad+5\cdot8+6\cdot3+7\cdot2=109. \end{aligned}\]

The mean is \(\frac{109}{25}=4.36\) days.

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Compute the weighted average from the bar heights.
First find the total number of students, then find the total number of reported exercise days.
